Metadata.title: Workaholics
Metadata.description: A community where makers show their work and get honest feedback.

Home.title: Workaholics
Home.tagline: Build things. Share them. Help each other.

Health.title: Platform status
Health.unreachable: The platform can't be reached. Try again later.

ResponseChip.overdue: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} overdue
ResponseChip.answered: Answered in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

PublicBadge.publicTitle: Everyone can see this, not only members

State.unreachableTitle: We can't reach the Workaholics platform right now
State.unreachableBody: The site is up but data isn't coming through. Anything you typed stays on this page; send it again once the connection is back.
State.errorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes; if it still fails, send us this code.

Auth.signInHint: You sign in with your Telegram account; there is no password.
Auth.inviteHint: The code the member who invited you sent you.
Auth.notMember: Not a member yet? Membership is by invitation.
Auth.welcome: Welcome! Complete your handle and bio so others know who you are.
Auth.emailHint: If you connected an email address to your account, you can sign in with it too. Email can't be used to join; membership is by invitation.
Auth.emailSent: If this address belongs to a member, a six-digit code is on its way. Enter it here.
Auth.emailUnavailable: Email sign-in isn't available right now. Sign in with Telegram, or try again later.

Errors.invite_required: You need an invite code to join. If you are already a member, sign in with the Telegram account you joined with.
Errors.invite_invalid: This invite code is not valid or has already been used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
Errors.invite_expired: This invite code has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
Errors.telegram_signature_invalid: Telegram sign-in could not be verified. Please try again.
Errors.sign_in_failed: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
Errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a little while.
Errors.session_required: Please sign in again to continue.
Errors.unreachable: We can't reach the server right now. Please try again shortly.
Errors.validation_failed: Some fields are not filled in correctly.
Errors.not_project_owner: Only the project's owners can do this.
Errors.last_owner: A project needs at least one owner.
Errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
Errors.notFoundBody: The address may be wrong, or the page was removed.
Errors.own_project: You can't give feedback on your own project.
Errors.not_author: Only the author can edit this.
Errors.reply_not_allowed: Only the person who gave the feedback and the project's owners can reply here.
Errors.not_current_response: This is no longer the current answer. Reload the page.
Errors.recheck_required: For “Test it”, say when you'll report back.
Errors.acted_on_invalid: You can only pick answered feedback on this project.
Errors.case_feedback_invalid: You can only pick answered feedback on this project's posts.
Errors.case_post_invalid: You can only pick this project's updates.
Errors.on_probation: Until your new-member period is over, you can't make anything public, change public work or invite anyone.
Errors.invite_limit_reached: You can't create a new invite right now. Once one of your open invites is used, revoked or expires, you can create another.
Errors.invite_not_open: This invite is no longer open: it was used, it expired or it was already revoked.
Errors.already_reported: You already reported this, and the moderators have your report.
Errors.confirm_mismatch: What you typed doesn't match your handle. Type your handle exactly as shown.
Errors.sole_owner: Your account wasn't deleted: you are the only owner of a project others gave feedback on. Add another owner to it first.
Errors.last_admins: Your account wasn't deleted: without you the community wouldn't have enough admins. Another admin has to be appointed first.
Errors.last_identity: This is your only way to sign in, so it can't be removed.
Errors.identity_in_use: This address is connected to another account. Use a different address.
Errors.identity_already_connected: An email address is already connected to your account. To connect a different one, remove it first.
Errors.email_code_invalid: This code is wrong or no longer valid. Ask for a new code and try again.
Errors.sign_in_method_unavailable: Email isn't available right now. Please try again later.

errors.handlePattern: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and _ only, starting with a letter.
errors.slugPattern: Lowercase Latin letters and digits only, with hyphens between words.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a full address that starts with http or https.
errors.linkIncomplete: Fill in both the label and the address.
errors.slugTaken: This project address is not available.
errors.dateInvalid: Pick a date from tomorrow up to six months ahead.
errors.reasonRequired: Write the reason. An answer without a reason isn't saved.

Links.hint: Up to {max, number} links, such as a website or a code repository.
Links.label: Link {n, number} label

Profile.handleHint: It appears in your page's address.
Profile.bioHint: What are you building, and what feedback are you looking for?
Profile.noScores: There are no followers or scores here, only work and feedback.
Profile.invitedOrder: In the order they joined, earliest first
Profile.invitedEmpty: No one has joined with their invite yet.
Profile.invitedEmptySelf: No one has joined with your invite yet.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.name: Project name
Projects.slugHint: It is used in the project page's address and cannot be changed later.
Projects.ownersHint: Every owner can edit the project and add or remove other owners.
Projects.onlyOwners: Only the project's owners can edit it.
Projects.timelineEmpty: There are no posts on this project yet.
Projects.timelineEmptyOwner: Write the first post: show your work in progress and say what feedback you want.

Posts.kindWipHint: Show unfinished work and ask for the feedback you want.
Posts.kindUpdateHint: Say what you did with the feedback.
Posts.question: Question {n, number}
Posts.questionsHint: At least one question, at most five. People giving feedback answer these.
Posts.selfCritiqueHint: Where do you think the work is weak?
Posts.whatChangedHint: What have you done since the last post?
Posts.actedOnHint: The answered feedback these changes came from.
Posts.actedOnEmpty: There is no answered feedback on this project yet.
Posts.oneNumberHint: One sentence with one number, in your own words, for example “3 of 5 people finished sign-up”.
Posts.onlyOwners: Only the project's owners post here.
Posts.editClosed: This post can no longer be edited: the 15-minute window has closed.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.order: Awaiting ones first, then in time order
Feedback.emptyAnswered: No feedback has been answered yet.
Feedback.composerHint: Say specifically what you saw and what you suggest. The owner answers it: accepts it, rejects it or tests it.
Feedback.goodBody: Answer the post's questions, point at one specific thing, and say why.
Feedback.ruleBody: Answer every piece of feedback within 7 days: accept, reject or test it, always with a reason. After 7 days, how long it has been overdue shows next to it.
Feedback.savedFeedback: Your feedback is in. The project's owners will be notified.
Feedback.savedAnswer: Answer saved. <n>{name}</n> will be notified and can reply.
Feedback.givenEmptySelf: You haven't given any feedback yet.

Answer.acceptedMeaning: It's right, and you'll act on it.
Answer.rejectedMeaning: You won't act on it, and you say why.
Answer.testingMeaning: You don't know yet; you'll test it and report back by the date you set.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.reply_received: <n>{actor}</n> replied in a feedback thread on <n>{project}</n>.
Notifications.response_due: Feedback on <n>{project}</n> has waited five days for your answer.
Notifications.telegramBody: To get these notifications and the weekly summary in Telegram, open the Workaholics bot and press Start. Send /stop any time to turn it off.
Notifications.telegramOn: These notifications also go to your Telegram. Send /stop to the bot to turn that off.
Notifications.credit_requested: <n>{actor}</n> linked your feedback in a case on <n>{project}</n> and asks whether you want to be named.

Awaiting.title: Awaiting my answer
Awaiting.intro: Feedback on your projects that hasn't been answered yet, oldest first.
Awaiting.empty: No feedback is waiting for your answer.

Visibility.inheritHint: Public when the project is public; otherwise only members see it.
Visibility.membersHint: Only members see it, even when the project is public.
Visibility.publicHint: Anyone with the link can read it without signing in, even when the project is members-only.
Visibility.feedbackNote: Feedback, answers and replies are never public.
Visibility.channelNote: A public update is also announced in the public Telegram channel once its 15-minute editing window closes.
Visibility.changeAnyTime: Any owner of the project can change this at any time; it doesn't count as an edit.
Visibility.effectivePublic: Right now anyone with the link can see this.
Visibility.effectiveMembers: Right now only members can see this.

PublicPages.projectNote: This is the public page of a project on Workaholics. It shows only what the project's owners made public.
PublicPages.timelineEmpty: There are no public posts on this project yet.
PublicPages.projectMembersOnly: The project's own page is visible only to members.
PublicPages.feedbackMembersOnly: Feedback on this post, and the owners' answers to it, are visible only to members.

Changelog.title: Changelog
Changelog.intro: This project's updates, newest first: what changed, which feedback it came from, and what was rejected and why.
Changelog.introPublic: This project's public updates, newest first: what changed, and what was rejected and why.
Changelog.empty: There are no updates on this project yet.
Changelog.emptyPublic: There are no public updates on this project yet.
Changelog.emptyOwner: When you post an update, it shows here: say what changed and what you did with the feedback.

Cases.title: Cases
Cases.intro: Feedback → change → result: short stories the project's owners write about what a piece of feedback changed and what happened next.
Cases.empty: No cases have been written for this project yet.
Cases.emptyPublic: There are no public cases on this project yet.
Cases.emptyOwner: Write the first case: pick answered feedback, then say what you changed and what happened.
Cases.caseTitleHint: One line about what changed, for example “Sign-up got shorter”.
Cases.feedbackStoryHint: What feedback did you get, and about which part of the work?
Cases.changeHint: What did you change because of it?
Cases.resultHint: What happened after the change? Write it down even if it didn't work.
Cases.oneNumberHint: One sentence with one number, in your own words, for example “Sign-up went from 5 minutes to 2”.
Cases.feedbackLinkedHint: At least one, at most ten pieces of answered feedback on this project.
Cases.feedbackLinkedEmpty: There is no answered feedback on this project yet. A case starts from answered feedback.
Cases.creditNote: Everyone whose feedback you pick is asked whether they want to be named. Until they say yes, the case says “a member” instead of their name.
Cases.postsLinkedHint: Up to ten of this project's updates that show the change.
Cases.postsLinkedEmpty: This project has no updates yet.
Cases.onlyOwners: Only the project's owners write cases here.
Cases.editNote: The project's owners can edit a case at any time; it then shows as edited. A case can't be deleted.

Credits.title: Feedback from
Credits.consentBody: This case links your feedback. Choose whether your name is shown with it. Until you say yes, the case says “a member” instead of your name.
Credits.statePending: You haven't chosen yet; the case says “a member”.
Credits.stateGiven: Your name is shown in this case.
Credits.stateDeclined: Your name isn't shown; the case says “a member”.
Credits.changeAnyTime: You can change this at any time.

Practice.title: Monthly practice numbers
Practice.intro: Five numbers for the whole community, one set per month. They are never shown per member, per project or per owner.
Practice.noShareLabel: No feedback was due this month
Practice.empty: No month has been computed yet. Each month's numbers appear at the start of the next month.
Practice.ruleMonths: Months are calendar months (Gregorian) in UTC.
Practice.ruleMembers: Members: active members who joined before the month ended.
Practice.ruleMembersPostingWip: Members posting work in progress: members who posted at least one work-in-progress post that month.
Practice.ruleProjectsWithPublicChangelog: Products with a public changelog: projects that were public when the month's numbers were computed and had at least one public update before the month ended.
Practice.ruleFeedbackAnsweredInWindow: Feedback answered within 7 days: a piece of feedback counts in the month its 7-day window closes, at the moment it would show as overdue (8 whole days after it was given). Of those, the share whose first answer came before that moment, as a whole percent rounded down. When no feedback was due, the page shows a dash.
Practice.ruleCasesWritten: Cases written: cases created that month.
Practice.ruleOnce: A month's numbers are computed once, at the start of the next month, and never changed afterwards. Each set records the version of these rules it was computed with.
Practice.rulesLink: All the rules the platform computes

Badge.snippetHint: Put this code on your own site or README: it shows the badge and links to this project's public page. The badge shows no number.

Export.title: Your data
Export.body: Download everything you created here as one JSON file: your profile, projects, posts, feedback, answers, replies, cases, credits and the invites you made.
Export.failed: The file couldn't be prepared. Try again in a few minutes.

Hidden.title: Hidden by moderation
Hidden.note: Its text is kept but not shown. Every moderation action is recorded in the moderation log.

Reports.reasonPost: Why are you reporting this post?
Reports.reasonFeedback: Why are you reporting this feedback?
Reports.reasonReply: Why are you reporting this reply?
Reports.reasonHint: Say which rule it breaks, or what is wrong with it.
Reports.note: Only moderators and admins see who reported. A report hides nothing by itself; if something is hidden, it appears in the moderation log.
Reports.sent: Your report is in. The moderators will look at it.

ModerationLog.title: Moderation log
ModerationLog.intro: Every time something is hidden or restored, or someone is given or loses the moderator or admin role, it is recorded here, newest first. It shows the role of whoever acted, never their name.
ModerationLog.empty: No moderation action has been recorded yet.
ModerationLog.roleGranted: A member was given the {role} role.

Invites.title: Your invites
Invites.intro: Membership in Workaholics is by invitation only. Invite someone who shows unfinished work and answers feedback. Their page will say you invited them.
Invites.limitNote: Each member can hold only a few open invites at a time. An invite that is used, revoked or expires frees its place.
Invites.probationNote: You can invite others once your new-member period is over.
Invites.createdOnce: This code and link are shown only this once. Copy them now and send them to the person you're inviting.
Invites.empty: You haven't created any invites yet.
Invites.revokeHint: A revoked invite code stops working.

Probation.title: Your new-member period
Probation.body: During this period you can post, give feedback, answer feedback and write cases. Making work public, changing public work and inviting others become possible after it.
Probation.feedbackPending: You still need to give feedback on others' work.
Probation.feedbackMet: You have given the feedback it asks for.
Probation.publicOption: The “Public” option opens after your new-member period.

Account.title: Account
Account.intro: Your sign-in methods, your data and account deletion.
Account.deleteHint: Your personal data is erased, and deletion can't be undone. Feedback and replies others responded to stay, shown as “a former member”.

SignInMethods.title: Sign-in methods
SignInMethods.intro: You can sign in with any of these. Only you see your email address here.
SignInMethods.telegramNote: Telegram is the way you joined, and it can't be removed.
SignInMethods.addHint: If you can't reach Telegram, you can sign in with this address too. We send a six-digit code to it to make sure it's yours.
SignInMethods.codeSent: We sent a six-digit code to <n>{address}</n>. Enter it here.
SignInMethods.unavailable: Adding an email isn't available right now. Please try again later.

Deletion.title: Delete your account
Deletion.intro: Deleting your account erases your personal data, and you can no longer sign in. There is no way to bring the account back.
Deletion.exportFirst: Download your data before you delete; afterwards you can't.
Deletion.kept: Feedback, answers and replies others responded to, posts others gave feedback on, and cases you wrote in projects that remain all stay, shown as “a former member”.
Deletion.erased: Your name, bio, links, sign-in methods, notifications, open invites and your choices about being named in cases are erased, as is everything you wrote that nobody responded to, and the projects you alone own that nobody gave feedback on.
Deletion.coOwned: Projects you own with others just lose you as an owner.
Deletion.confirmHint: To confirm, type <n>{handle}</n> exactly as shown.
Deletion.soleOwnerBody: You are the only owner of these projects, and others gave feedback on them. Add another owner to each, then try again.
